faqs.question: What does 👌🔥 mean from a stranger?
faqs.answer: From a stranger 👌🔥 usually reads as a public-coded reaction. The combo is the same on comment sections regardless of relationship.

faqs.question: Does 👌🔥 work in family chats?
faqs.answer: Yes — 👌🔥 lands well in family chats when the recipient already understands reaction-coded cues.

faqs.question: How do I reply to 👌🔥?
faqs.answer: Mirror 👌🔥 with another reaction emoji or a sentence that joins the moment. The cleanest reply keeps the same intensity register.

faqs.question: Is 👌🔥 flirty?
faqs.answer: 👌🔥 is not flirty by default. The reaction register is broader than flirting; reach for flirt-coded combos when attraction is the point.
